London, 1<sup>st</sup> May 2009 



# Norilsk Nickel Daily News Digest 

**Chrysler LLC** , battered by collapsing U.S. sales and a global credit crisis, filed for bankruptcy and announced an industry-changing deal with Fiat S.p.A. Despite intense negotiations over the past few weeks, Chrysler failed to gain the full support from its lenders to avoid the first-ever bankruptcy filing by a major U.S. automaker. Fiat will take an initial stake of 20 percent, and the Italian automaker can become the majority owner once the government loans are repaid.  Chrysler CEO Robert Nardelli will step down once the bankruptcy is complete. Co President Tom Lasorda is retiring.   Chrysler will switch from Chrysler Financial to GMAC Financial Services for dealer financing; reduce its dealership roster by an unspecified amount; and idle most plants during the 30 to 60 days it expects to be in bankruptcy. The first hearing in the case is scheduled for 10 a.m. Friday in the New York court.  The legal proceedings will be administered by Judge Arthur Gonzalez, the same jurist who oversaw the Enron Corp. and WorldCom Inc. bankruptcies. As part of Chrysler’s filing, the U.S. government will provide up to $3.5 billion in debtor-in-possession (DIP) financing and up to $4.5 billion in exit financing. Obama, during a noon address in Washington, said he hopes the entire bankruptcy process will take no more than 60 days. The bankruptcy signals that Obama is prepared to play hardball with holdout lenders rather than knuckle under to their demands and will likely set the tone for similar discussions with bondholders of General Motors -- which is to restructure its operations by the end of May.  This is not the first major government action with Chrysler. In 1980, U.S. President Jimmy Carter signed a bill providing Chrysler with more than $1 billion in loan guarantees. _Source:  Automotive News_ 

**Chrysler LLC** will idle most of its plants during its time in bankruptcy.  The shutdown begins Monday and will stretch through the 30 to 60 days it is expected to take to restructure in Chapter 11 bankruptcy. General Motors also plans to shut most of its plants for nine weeks beginning in May _Source:  Automotive News_ 

**April U.S. light-vehicle sales** will return to January levels on stable retail sales rates and fleet sales that increased from February and March, analysts say. Six analysts surveyed by Automotive News gave an average seasonally adjusted sales rate of 9.8 million units, the same as January’s results and down from 14.7 million units in April 2008. Demand fell to 9.1 million units in February, the lowest since December 1981, before increasing to 9.3 million units in March.  Sales of vehicles to individual customers have remained stable from February through April,so any increase in demand reflects increased fleet sales. _Source: Automotive News_ 

**GM and Chrysler** will suffer declines of more than one-third compared with year-ago levels, analysts said. Ford sales

will be down from 27.2 to 3%, analysts predicted. Toyota U.S.A.’s sales will fall by more than a third, while American Honda and Nissan North America will see drops of about a quarter from April 2008, the analysts said.  A Reuters poll of 36 economists predicted an April sales rate of 9.8 million units. Analysts are predicting a sales recovery in H208. _Source:  Automotive News_ 

**A unique bridal gown** made with platinum fabric was showcased recently by designer Domo Adami. The bodice is made up of draped platinum fabric laid on a structure of duchess satin and hempen cloth interlining.  The wedding gown will be available only in limited and numbered pieces. Each dress will be labeled with the bride’s name hand-embroidered on the inner lining. It costs 30,000 Euros. The world’s most expensive suit was unveiled in London. The “Alexander Amosu,” named after the designer, could be yours for just over $100,000. Each suit will be a one-off creation made from gold and platinum threads, the rarest silks and a blend of Himalayan Pashmina, Qiviuk and Vicuna. And, to complete the garment, nine 18-carat gold and pave set diamond buttons will be sewn into place. _Source:  Israeli Diamond/ abc News_
